title: Parking Aid Camera — Component Locations
introduction:
I use this drawing as a treasure map for the camera-equipped parking aid: start with an enlarged component view, match its callout to the table, then follow the leader line to its location in the transparent car. The centerstack display is at the dashboard, the rear parking aid camera is at the rear of the car, and the BCM is shown in the front cabin area.

The display illustration shows FDIM, the front display interface module; FCDIM, the front control/display interface module, is described as similar. Keep that qualifier when matching the drawing to the installed display. This reference establishes component identities and general locations. Access, connector details, electrical tests and fault decisions require their own instructions.

edits.why: Use the table to name each illustrated component and the leader lines to place it in the car. The enlarged views help with recognition; their connecting lines indicate locations, not electrical connections between components.
